messages:
sara: Heads-up — after yesterday's QA deploy the debug logger started persisting full request payloads. Retention is 30d and I'm seeing user PII (emails, phone numbers) in S3.
jamal: ugh. do you have the path + a redacted sample?
sara: s3://redwood-logs/debug/2026/03/19/ingest.log.gz
sara: ```\n{"request_id":"r-123","user":{"email":"alice@example.com","phone":"+1-555-1234"},"payload":"..."}\n```\n(this is a gzip snippet, redacted here)
olivia: Is that stream also getting forwarded to Splunk/our SIEM? If so we may have PII in an external system.
sara: yes — the forwarder rule `forward.debug` currently sends a filtered stream to splunk_heavy_forwarder for retention/alerts.
luca: two immediate concerns: (1) who has read access to that S3 prefix and can decrypt objects (SSE-KMS), (2) if we rotate the CMK we need to re-wrap or we lose ability to decrypt old objects unless AWS handles it via key policy/alias mapping.
jamal: we use SSE-KMS (aws:kms) with envelope encryption. rotating the alias -> new key id is fine but existing objects still encrypted with old CMK. re-wrap needed if we want to change algorithm or move to customer-managed vs AWS-managed.
sec-ops-bot: INCIDENT OPENED: INC-2026-042 - Potential PII in debug logs. Pager: @olivia
olivia: Temporary containment steps I propose now:
- immediately reduce debug log retention from 30d -> 7d for the ingest pipeline
- disable `forward.debug` to Splunk until we confirm scrubbing
- snapshot current objects (S3 immutable copy) and tag as `pii-review`
- schedule a redact job to rewrite objects with masked fields for last 30d
- create JIT unmask flow for on-call access (SSO approval + 1h TTL)
sara: i've reduced retention on the bucket lifecycle (rule id: debug-short-ret) and turned off the forwarder (rolling restart applied). changes pushed via infra PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/1284
jjamal: i'll own the redact job. plan: stream objects, run an inline transform to replace "email":"[^"]+" -> "email":"REDACTED", same for phone. will write using a new prefix debug-redacted/ with same metadata.
jjamal: sample transform (splunk/sed style):
```bash
sed -E 's/("email"\s*:\s*")[^\"]+(" )/\1REDACTED\2/g' | sed -E 's/("phone"\s*:\s*")[^\"]+(" )/\1REDACTED\2/g'
```
olivia: also we must update the Splunk forwarder config to mask at ingestion so future events never leave clean. example props/transforms hack:
```ini
# props.conf
[MESSAGE]
REPORT-extract = extract_payload

# transforms.conf
[extract_payload]
REGEX = ("email"\s*:\s*")[^\"]+(\")
FORMAT = $1REDACTED$2
```
luca: on the KMS side — i'll audit the key policy and list which principals are in the Decrypt perms. if we want JIT unmasking we should ensure decryption requires the `security:unmask` role and an ephemeral session. we can use STS AssumeRoleWithSAML -> short-lived creds bound to a session tag and KMS condition on `aws:PrincipalTag/role=unmask`.
olivia: for RBAC change: propose a new permission `logs:unmask` gated to group `security-sre-oncall`. approvals via our access-request flow, token TTL 1h. i'll open a draft PR for the cloud-iam catalog.
sara: quick Q re: rewrap: can we call the KMS re-encrypt API on every object? That could be heavy.
luca: we can run a parallel rewrap lambda that reads object, calls `ReEncrypt` with new CMK, and writes back. costs are read+write + KMS ops. alternative: keep old CMK with a restricted key policy and only allow Decrypt for security service account.
jamal: redact job ETA ~4h to get first 24h done, full 30d may take ~8-12h depending on throughput. will run during low-traffic window.
olivia: next steps & owners:
- sara: confirm retention + forwarder disabled (done) :white_check_mark:
- jamal: redact job + debug-redacted prefix (ETA 4–12h) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
- luca: KMS key policy audit + rewrap plan (ETA EOD) :mag:
- olivia: PR for `logs:unmask` RBAC + JIT playbook (link to PR when ready) :memo:
- sec-ops-bot: create incident timeline and notify compliance (done)

sara: one more ask — once redact job finishes, please run a quick validation script to ensure no `@` characters remain in the email fields before we re-enable forwarders.
jamal: yup will validate with `jq` regex.
olivia: schedule 15min post-mortem once containment done; invite infra, devex, compliance. meeting at 15:00 UTC if everyone ok.
luca: noted, i'll also check whether Glacier-archived logs were also included (they are in a different bucket). if so we'll need a separate restore+redact.
sec-ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: containment steps applied. Severity: medium. Tags: pii, logs, kms
sara: thanks all. appreciate the quick responses. :thumbsup:
